cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Two office biscuits are missing. We've got an organised operation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. A confession this quick suggests training.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they're recruiting through hunger. This goes higher than the biscuit tin.

mechanism: A authorizes an investigation and treats B ordinary explanations as evidence for an expanding organizational threat.
confusable: Suspicion alone is not enough: each minor detail must enlarge the inferred problem, with A deciding what explanations and actions are admissible.
comparison: Biscuit consumption becomes a recruitment theory; the email alternative turns a forgotten send into an institutional succession crisis.
seedUse: Use D24-a quick admission and hunger, making S01 permission govern how ordinary explanations are heard.
